# Breadcrumb > Location trail with links, the current page, and collapsed levels. This file matches the installed `breadcrumb` source. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### breadcrumb - `--cui-breadcrumb-list-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-breadcrumb-page-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-breadcrumb-link-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/breadcrumb - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/breadcrumb.json
